  PROBLEM: cmd_pack can emit a V2 chunk chain whose declared total exceeds MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST.

  PROBLEM: post_state_comment returns 1 on every V2 failure path without a legacy V1 persistence fallback.
  WHY: Callers swallow the error with `|| true`, so failed V2 writes leave only stale persisted state and can replay work; reviewers split between high and critical severity.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:314-453 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast, z-ai_glm-5]

  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: post_tracking_comment may marshal the full comment body through argv, risking MAX_ARG_STRLEN failures.

  WHY: `re.sub(r"\\(.)", r"\1", pattern)` does not consume backslash-newline pairs, so a valid re.escape output can miss the overlap dedup path.

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:137 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack can emit chains the extractor will reject because total is not capped by MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST.
  WHY: _try_parse_v2_chunk() rejects any chain where total > MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST, so large states become unreadable and the orchestrator can fall back to stale V1 state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1041-1094 | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: post_state_comment has no V1 fallback on any V2 failure path.
  WHY: Helper-missing, pack-failure, zero-chunk, and chunk-post-failure paths all return 1, and callers use `|| true`, so stale persisted state can be reused next poll cycle.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:327-453 | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: There are no test cases that exercise V2-specific failure modes.
  WHY: The suite has V2 parsing support, but it does not cover pack exceeding the manifest cap, chunk post failure with fallback, corrupted V2 chains, or mixed V1/V2 comments.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:119-138 | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: _looks_like_re_escape_output fails on patterns with literal newlines.
  WHY: The `re.sub(r"\\(.)", r"\1", pattern)` unescape does not match backslash-newline pairs, so genuine re.escape output with newlines fails the round-trip check.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_state_v2.py:138-145 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: cmd_pack() computes total chunks without checking against MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST.
  WHY: The writer can emit a chain that the reader rejects when total > 1024, making large states unreadable and causing stale-state reprocessing.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1041-1100 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: post_state_comment() has no V1 fallback when V2 persistence fails.
  WHY: Helper-missing, pack-failure, zero-chunk, and chunk-post-failure paths all return 1 with no legacy persistence path, and callers swallow the error with `|| true`.
- tests/test_orchestrate_poll_process.py:322 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Regression tests for V2 persistence do not exist.
  WHY: The test file does not include the claimed V2 pack/fallback cases, so V2 regressions can pass CI undetected.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1019-1028 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: post_tracking_comment() may hit argv-size limits by passing the full comment body through `jq -n --arg`.
  WHY: Large comment bodies can exceed Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN, unlike the stdin-based V2 path.
- scripts/verify_integration_fingerprints.py:119-137 | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: _looks_like_re_escape_output has a literal-newline round-trip edge case.
  WHY: `re.sub(r"\\(.)", r"\1", pattern)` does not handle newline characters, so a valid escaped pattern can fail the fixed-point check.
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

  PROBLEM: cmd_pack() is missing MAX_CHUNKS_PER_MANIFEST validation before emitting chunks.
